reviews.comment: Genuinely the worst Professor I have had. In no way does she even attempt to set the class up for success. She has no exam reviews study guides, nor does she teach how to solve exam/hw problems during class. If you want a class where you will have to learn everything yourself but still have to attend class for 10% of your grade, she's great.

she's very nice and stuff, i really think she should have taught history or something because all she does is talk about everything but the class material. All of the question are stolen from the textbook and class doesn't help with material.
She's nice and likes this subject, but I felt the stars leaving my eyes. I would genuinely rather eat poop than do the work for this class. Inshallah praying for the curve! Wallahi I'm finished
Lectures were not helpful or useful for homeworks or exams. Would not recommend.

The course itself is really difficult, but if you're able to follow the homework you should be alright on exams. It's very self-taught though since most of lectures are just her reading off the already confusing slides. She basically expects you to learn everything from the textbook.

Not a fantastic professor, homework was easy since you had unlimited time and attempts, just make sure to pay attention as the exams are half conceptual and half practical. She reads off the slides and the slides were pretty bad, so I would steer clear if possible. Not an easy class and not made easier by Dr. Marshall.

Lectures are essentially useless. Homeworks are super convoluted, and most of the feedback on the questions missed offers little to no insight on how to complete the question correctly. All the exams and homework are math-based yet she never even touches a single math problem in class and just reads off the slides. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!

Very nice person but a very irritating class. It seems like the homework is made to be as convoluted and annoying to complete as possible. Homework and exams are nearly 100% math based; the math is NOT covered in class. Zero practice problems in lecture. Just reading off of slides with no words or context for reviewing after the fact.
Awful, all she does is talk and read off the slides. Does no examples and says to review "everything" for the exam.

She's a great person but is the worst lecturer I've ever had - she reads straight off the slides (which are horrible). There's a lot of content taught that isn't on exams but you never know what is or isn't. The homework consistently has mistakes and isn't similar to exams. Exams grading seems subjective. She's a great person but a TERRIBLE prof.

ASTR 314 is definitely not an easy class, but it is more than doable if you actually put in effort and show up to lectures. I don't really get the other low ratings as I got 98% as my final grade. Exams are very similar to homework questions, so as long as you get 100 on homework (unlimited attempts), you can ace the test. She also gives good curve

I hate her and her class. Her hw assignments are unclear(you can have the right answer and still be wrong), and the way she grades exams is wrong. you could have gotten the right answer but the grader will mark it wrong but your friend could put the same answer and have it marked correct. she is disorganized and reads from slides. I learned nothing

If you are not an expert in coding... DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Class is made up of attendance, homework (ONLY coding), and a final project. Lectures are boring and help with absolutely nothing on the homework codes. She has no office hours, and does not help with any codes, she will send you only to her TA, or tell you to "google it"

Hw is due once a week and is easy. Lab helps you understand concepts better and boosts your grade. If you read over the ppts yourself, and make sure you have a general understanding you will be fine .Tests are not that hard if you study well for a few days prior. The class is interesting for sure. Study well for the final and you can get an A.

It's an interesting class and all but her lectures are pretty boring because she just reads off a ppt with the lights off. The labs were kind of pointless but I liked them just because the TA was super charismatic and I was able to learn a lot about the subject from him. Definitely not a hard class at all.

Marshall is pretty important in astronomy and knows what she's doing. Her class is based off ppts and she gives out random in-class assignments that are just to take attendance for a 5% participation grade. The actual content is not hard as long as you can memorize stuff, the homework and labs are easy, and the final is based off the other tests.

I'm an astronomy minor and I found the lectures boring. She's really monotone and teaches with the lights off. The tests were easy for me. You probably could make an A without going to class. I would recommend taking if you need some sort of extra science credit.

Dr. Marshall is highly respected in her field, and is overall a good professor. She is very kind, and loves what she teaches. Her lectures can get dull sometimes, but overall the class isn't too hard. First exam is middle school stuff, while the second and third get into some physics and memorization. Not the most fun, but definitely passable.

Dr. Marshall has an incredible background, great learning from someone who very clearly knows what's she's doing. Dr. Marshall is very friendly and has enjoyable lectures that provide ample information to those truly interested in astronomy without boring those there to get their science credit. Labs are awesome! DON'T buy the book, & go to class!
